ns2:section.sectionText: This course will be an exploration of the meaning, basis, historical roots, and practical significance of human rights, with special attention given to the questions of their universality. Not intended for students with Freshman class standing. Students may receive only three hours of credit for PS 300. International relations subfield. Restricted to political science majors until November 15.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Not intended for students with Freshman class standing.
